scope: Daily incoming-radiation and sunshine measurements at King's Park, Kowloon, from 2020. Produced by scripts/ingest/fetch_hko_cis.py. Added because the HK database carries hourly temperature, humidity, pressure, wind and visibility but no radiation term, which photochemical ozone questions need.

files.radiation_hko.csv: One row per date: global solar radiation (MJ/m2), bright sunshine duration (hours), pan evaporation (mm), each with the observatory's own completeness flag.

sources.title: Climatological Information Service — daily element records, King's Park Meteorological Station
sources.notes: Element codes GSR, SUN and EVAP for station KP. The published record starts 1978-11 for radiation; this extract keeps 2020 onward to match the corpus window. Values marked *** in the source are unobserved and become NA here; the completeness column is carried through unchanged as C (complete), # (incomplete) or blank. The same endpoint pattern also serves TEMP, RH, MSLP, WSPD and RF, deliberately not taken: the database already has those hourly, and a coarser daily copy beside them would be a second source of truth for no gain.

station.notes: Coordinates and elevation are the IGRA station-list entry for HKM00045004, the radiosonde record at the same site, so radiation and the vertical profile share one location. NOT taken from the benchmark database's air_quality_station table, which this ingest cannot reach; King's Park is a meteorological station and is not one of the 18 EPD air-quality stations in any case.

verification.range: 0.67 to 28.77 MJ/m2 against a subtropical clear-sky ceiling near 30; no value out of range, none zero.
verification.seasonal_cycle: Monthly means run 12.3 (December) to 18.9 (July), with the May-June dip that Hong Kong's cloudy early summer produces.
verification.internal_consistency: Global solar radiation correlates with bright sunshine duration at r = 0.921.
verification.sunshine_ceiling: Longest day 12.2 h against a day length near 13.4 h at this latitude; no day exceeds it.
verification.completeness: 2,373 consecutive days with no gap and no duplicate date.
verification.spatial_representativeness: Against HKO's second radiation station, Kau Sai Chau (KSC), 2,367 shared days: daily r = 0.925, median absolute difference 1.05 MJ/m2 (7% of the mean), 26% of days differing by over 20%; monthly means r = 0.970.

known_limits: Daily totals only. Pairing them with hourly pollutant data forces an aggregation choice that a case must state.

One site, and its spatial reach is scale-dependent — measured against Kau Sai Chau (station KSC, 20 km east) over 2,367 overlapping days: monthly means correlate at r = 0.970, but daily totals only at r = 0.925, and on 26% of days the two stations differ by more than 20%. Treat monthly aggregates as territory-wide and a single day's total as local to Kowloon.
The HK database records begin 2024-12, so only the last ~1.7 years of this file has air-quality data to join to.
